title: Adding Transfection and Sample to Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: If transfection mix not selected, protocol will end

steps.title: Create CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file whose header reads exactly "sample well, sample slot, destination well" and list each sample’s source well, tube slot, destination well, and the volume to transfer (volumes are specified by the user). Include the header line in the file.

steps.title: Configure pipette and tips
steps.instruction: Select a P20 pipette for transfers ≤20 µL or a P300 pipette for larger volumes, as indicated by the user‑specified volumes in the CSV. Load the appropriate pipette tips; the protocol will pause automatically if tips run out and prompt the user to replace them.

steps.title: Enable liquid‑height tracking
steps.instruction: Activate liquid‑height tracking for the 50 mL source tubes so the pipette tip never submerges below the liquid surface during aspiration.

steps.title: Transfer samples to plate
steps.instruction: Using the configured pipette, aspirate each volume from the indicated source tube (sample slot) and dispense it into the corresponding destination well on the plate, following the order defined in the CSV file.

steps.title: Add transfection mix (optional)
steps.instruction: If a transfection mix has been selected, aspirate the user‑specified volume of transfection mix and add it to the appropriate wells of the plate; if no transfection mix is selected, terminate the protocol at this point.
